subject: Launch runbook walkthrough & cutover coordination
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@neptune-analytics.com>, Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@neptune-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch runbook walkthrough & cutover coordination

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the time last week. As we approach the planned production cutover, I want to get a single coordination call on the calendar to walk through the launch runbook, owners, fallback/rollback triggers, and procurement/ops checklist. Proposed agenda (60–90 min):

- Cutover window and exact timestamps (timezone alignment)
- Owner matrix (who executes each step)
- Rollback criteria & fallback policy
- Monitoring, alerting, and canary verification
- Security sign-off (SOC2 evidencing & access)
- Procurement/PO & invoicing handoff
- Dry-run timing (48h before)

Time options (PT):
- Thu Jul 2, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Thu Jul 2, 15:00–16:30 PT
- Fri Jul 3, 09:00–10:30 PT

Please tell me which slot works or suggest one; add any other stakeholders (e.g., security, procurement). I’ll circulate a runbook PDF and the cutover checklist before the call.

Thanks —
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Attachments: draft agenda (inline)

From: Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@neptune-analytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@neptune-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:05:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch runbook walkthrough & cutover coordination

Thanks Rishi —

We should add our security lead and procurement to the thread: I’m looping in Priya Shah (security) and our procurement alias. Quick notes from our side:

- Security wants to review the runbook for network access steps and confirm there are no plaintext logs with PII; Priya will prepare a short checklist.
- Procurement needs the final SOW and an invoice-ready summary to generate a PO. Our procurement timeline is tight: they aim to issue PO by Jul 6 if they get docs this week.
- Preferred slot: Thu Jul 2, 15:00–16:30 PT works for our engineers.

I’ve attached our PO requirements doc to this reply.

Best,
Elena
Director, Platform Engineering — Neptune Analytics

Thanks Elena — slot confirmed for Thu Jul 2, 15:00–16:30 PT unless there’s an objection.

Technical owners (proposed):
- Cutover lead: Marissa Cole (I’ll run the sequence and validate canaries)
- Rollback & DB/infra: Monica Patel (will manage rollback steps & data validation)
- Escalation exec: Markus Klein (on call for exec escalations)
- Deployment infra: Dev Patel (joining on cutover day)

I’ll attach a baseline runbook and a cutover checklist for review prior to the call. Please flag any missing items (network IP allowlist, maintenance windows, backup retention checks).

Agree on Thu Jul 2, 15:00–16:30 PT. A couple of operational asks from my side:

- Please schedule a 30–45 minute dry run 48 hours before the cutover. Proposal: Tue Jun 30, 09:00–09:45 PT (if that conflicts because of time, we can move it to Wed Jul 1, 09:00 PT). The dry run should validate end-to-end smoke tests and alerting rules.
- Developer support: I’ll have Dev Patel join the dry run and the cutover window.
- Monica: coordinate the rollback checklist with Priya (security) and confirm whether any additional audit logging is required for SOC review.

I’ll be on the escalation channel during the cutover. If procurement needs anything from finance, loop in Laura Bennett.

-Markus
VP, Customer Success, Redwood Inference

All — thanks for the quick responses. Summary & next steps: 

Confirmed meeting: Thu Jul 2, 15:00–16:30 PT (calendar invite sent: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/abc123).
Dry run: Wed Jul 1, 09:00–09:45 PT (Marissa/Dev to lead).
Owners: Marissa (cutover), Monica (rollback/data validation), Markus (exec escalation), Dev (deployment infra), Priya (security sign-off).
Procurement ask: Rishi to provide one-page SOW + invoice summary by EOD Jul 3 so Neptune can aim for PO issuance by Jul 6. Laura Bennett will be the billing contact at Redwood.
Security: Priya to send checklist; Monica will update runbook with logging/audit items.
Attachments (sent): redwood-launch-runbook-v1.pdf, cutover-checklist.xlsx — please review before the main call.
Action items (owners in parentheses):
- Send one-page SOW + invoice summary (Rishi) — due EOD Jul 3
- Priya to confirm security checklist items (Priya) — due before the main call
- Dry run schedule + dry-run test plan (Marissa) — due Jul 1 morning
- Update runbook with rollback details (Monica) — due Jul 2 12:00 PT

If anything changes or you need to shift the time, reply-all and we’ll reschedule. Looking forward to the run-through.

Best,
